lessons.name: Who's Going to Bell the Cat?

passageLines.text: There is a big mansion.
There is a hole in the kitchen.
A mouse family lives there.
They are Grandpa Mouse, Grandma Mouse, Mommy Mouse, Daddy Mouse, Brother Mouse, and Sister Mouse.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 할아버지 쥐, 할머니 쥐, 엄마 쥐, 아빠 쥐, 오빠 쥐, 그리고 여동생 쥐입니다.

passageLines.text: They are always hungry.
A cat lives in the kitchen.
The cat is always hungry, too.
He likes to eat mice.
He always waits for the mice in front of the hole.
passageLines.ko: 그는 항상 구멍 앞에서 쥐들을 기다립니다.

lessons.name: Who's Going to Bell the Cat?

passageLines.text: One day, Brother Mouse and Sister Mouse want to get some cheese from the table.
passageLines.ko: 어느 날, 형 쥐와 누나 쥐는 식탁에서 치즈를 좀 가져오고 싶어 합니다.

passageLines.text: They look outside the hole.
The cat is asleep near the table.
Brother Mouse quietly sneaks out of the hole.
passageLines.ko: 형 쥐는 조용히 구멍 밖으로 살금살금 나옵니다.

passageLines.text: He gets the cheese from the table.
Sister Mouse shouts for joy.
Oops!
The cat wakes up.
Brother Mouse panics.
He starts to run.
The cat chases him.
Oh, no!
He drops the cheese.
He runs into the hole quickly.
passageLines.ko: 그는 재빨리 구멍 안으로 뛰어 들어갑니다.

lessons.name: Who's Going to Bell the Cat?

passageLines.text: That evening, Brother Mouse and Sister Mouse tell the family what happened.
passageLines.ko: 그날 저녁, 오빠 쥐와 여동생 쥐는 가족에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 이야기합니다.

passageLines.text: The mouse family has a meeting.
They say they have to do something about the cat.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 고양이에 대해 뭔가 해야 한다고 말합니다.

passageLines.text: Then, Sister Mouse comes up with an idea.
passageLines.ko: 그때, 여동생 쥐는 한 가지 아이디어를 떠올립니다.

passageLines.text: "How about we tie a bell around the cat's neck?
Then we'll know when he's awake," says Sister Mouse.
passageLines.ko: 그러면 그가 깨어 있을 때를 알 수 있을 거예요.”라고 여동생 쥐가 말합니다.

passageLines.text: The mouse family likes the idea.
They are very excited.
They won't have to worry about the cat anymore.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 더 이상 고양이에 대해 걱정할 필요가 없을 거예요.

lessons.name: Who's Going to Bell the Cat?

passageLines.text: Daddy Mouse goes to his drawer.
He gets a long rope.
Mommy Mouse goes to her drawer.
She brings a golden bell.
So who's going to bell the cat?
passageLines.ko: 그럼 누가 고양이 목에 방울을 달 건가요?

passageLines.text: Grandpa Mouse asks.
The mouse family becomes quiet.
They blink their eyes and study each other.
They sigh and sigh.
Nobody is brave enough to do it.
passageLines.ko: 아무도 그것을 할 만큼 용감하지 않습니다.

lessons.name: A Naughty Spell for Naughty Boys.

passageLines.text: Tom and Jerry are twins.They look alike, feel alike, act alike, and do everything alike.
passageLines.ko: 톰과 제리는 쌍둥이다. 그들은 생김새도, 느끼는 것도, 행동하는 것도, 모든 것이 똑같다.

passageLines.text: What they dislike the most is going to school.
passageLines.ko: 그들이 가장 싫어하는 것은 학교에 가는 것이다.

passageLines.text: One Sunday night, Tom and Jerry search the Internet for a naughty spell.
passageLines.ko: 어느 일요일 밤, 톰과 제리는 장난스러운 주문을 찾기 위해 인터넷을 검색한다.

passageLines.text: They want to make their school disappear.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 자신들의 학교를 사라지게 하고 싶어 한다.

passageLines.text: After half an hour, they find a spell.

lessons.name: A Naughty Spell for Naughty Boys.

passageLines.text: Tom and Jerry dress up as wizards.
They get a huge black pot from the kitchen.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 부엌에서 커다란 검은 냄비를 가져옵니다.

passageLines.text: They put in five nail clippings, nine dead flies, some spider webs, and a smelly sock.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 손톱 조각 다섯 개, 죽은 파리 아홉 마리, 거미줄 약간, 그리고 냄새나는 양말 하나를 넣습니다.

passageLines.text: Tom and Jerry dance around the huge black pot and chant.
passageLines.ko: 톰과 제리는 커다란 검은 냄비 주위에서 춤을 추며 주문을 외웁니다.

passageLines.text: "Abracadabra!
Abracadabra!
Make the school disappear!
they say.
BOOM!
The huge black pot makes a big sound with purple smoke.
passageLines.ko: 커다란 검은 냄비에서 보라색 연기와 함께 큰 소리가 납니다.

passageLines.text: The purple smoke disappears.
Tom and Jerry look at each other.
They scream.
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!

lessons.name: A Naughty Spell for Naughty Boys.

passageLines.text: Tom has a cat's face and Jerry has a mouse's face.
passageLines.ko: 톰은 고양이 얼굴을 하고 있고 제리는 쥐 얼굴을 하고 있습니다.

passageLines.text: Tom and Jerry close their door and lock it.
They search the Internet all night to undo their naughty spell.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 자신들의 장난스러운 마법을 풀기 위해 밤새 인터넷을 검색합니다.

passageLines.text: But, they don't find anything.
Tired, they both fall asleep.
passageLines.ko: 피곤해서, 그들은 둘 다 잠이 듭니다.

passageLines.text: "Wake up, boys!
Time to go to school!
Tom and Jerry's mother says Tom and Jerry cover their faces and start to cry.
passageLines.ko: 톰과 제리의 엄마가 말하자 톰과 제리는 얼굴을 가리고 울기 시작합니다.

passageLines.text: "We can't go to school," they say.
passageLines.ko: “우리는 학교에 갈 수 없어요,” 그들이 말합니다.

passageLines.text: "We look like monsters."

lessons.name: A Naughty Spell for Naughty Boys.

passageLines.text: "What are you talking about?
Now, wake up," their mom says.
Tom and Jerry get out of bed.
They go to look at their faces in the mirror.
passageLines.ko: 그들은 거울에 비친 자신들의 얼굴을 보러 간다.

passageLines.text: HOORAY!
Tom and Jerry jump for joy.
"The naughty spell is gone!
Tom shouts.
"Come on!
Let's go to school!
Jerry shouts.
Tom and Jerry happily rush to school.

passageLines.text: There is a tree.
There is a boy named John.
The tree loves John.
John loves the tree, too.
He comes to see the tree every day.
The tree is very happy.
"Tree, I want to play king," says John.
passageLines.ko: “나무야, 나는 왕 놀이를 하고 싶어.” 존이 말합니다.

passageLines.text: The tree gives John leaves.
John makes a leaf crown and plays king.
passageLines.ko: 존은 나뭇잎 왕관을 만들고 왕 놀이를 합니다.

passageLines.text: The tree is very happy.
"Tree, I want to play hide-and-seek," says John.
The tree says it will be "it".
passageLines.ko: 나무는 자기가 술래를 할 거라고 말해요.

passageLines.text: John runs and hides behind the tree.
The tree is very happy.
"Tree, I want to take a nap," says John.
passageLines.ko: “나무야, 나 낮잠 자고 싶어.” 존이 말해요.

passageLines.text: The tree sings a lullaby.
John closes his eyes, and soon falls asleep.
passageLines.ko: 존은 눈을 감고 곧 잠이 들어요.

passageLines.text: The tree is very happy.
One day, John stops coming to see the tree.
passageLines.ko: 어느 날, 존은 나무를 보러 오지 않습니다.

passageLines.text: The tree doesn't know why.
The tree waits for John.
John doesn't come to see the tree.
The tree is very sad.
Many years pass.
One day, John comes to see the tree.
passageLines.ko: 어느 날, 존은 나무를 보러 옵니다.

passageLines.text: He is in his twenties.
He is a young man.
"Tree, I want some money," says John.
passageLines.ko: “나무야, 나는 돈이 좀 필요해.”라고 존이 말합니다.

passageLines.text: "I don't have any money," says the tree.
"But, I can give you fruit.
passageLines.ko: “하지만, 나는 너에게 열매를 줄 수 있어.

passageLines.text: You can sell it.
John takes the tree's fruit.
The tree is very happy.
After a long time, John comes to see the tree.
passageLines.ko: 오랜 시간이 흐른 뒤, 존이 나무를 보러 옵니다.

passageLines.text: He is in his forties.
He is a middle-aged man.
"Tree, I want to build a house," says John.
passageLines.ko: “나무야, 나는 집을 짓고 싶어.” 존이 말합니다.

passageLines.text: "You can take my branches," says the tree.
"You can also take my trunk.
John takes the tree's branches and trunk.
The tree is very happy.
After a very long time, John comes to see the tree.
passageLines.ko: 아주 오랜 시간이 흐른 뒤, 존이 나무를 보러 옵니다.

passageLines.text: He is in his sixties.
He is an old man.
"John, I don't have anything to give you," says the tree.
passageLines.ko: “존, 나는 너에게 줄 것이 아무것도 없어.” 나무가 말합니다.

passageLines.text: "I'm sorry.
"Don't be," says John.
"I just need some rest.
passageLines.ko: 나는 그저 좀 쉬고 싶을 뿐이야.

passageLines.text: John sits on the stump.
He rests without saying a word.
passageLines.ko: 그는 아무 말도 하지 않고 쉽니다.

passageLines.text: The tree is very happy.
My name is Spotty.
I'm a dog.
I live with Mr. and Mrs. Anderson and their daughter, Jane.
passageLines.ko: 나는 앤더슨 씨 부부와 그들의 딸 제인과 함께 살아.

passageLines.text: People from the neighborhood say I'm special.
I don't know why I'm special.
I just do what I feel is right.
passageLines.ko: 나는 그저 내가 옳다고 느끼는 것을 할 뿐이야.

passageLines.text: On Monday, I play with Jane outside.

passageLines.text: Remember, always walk on the pavement!

passageLines.ko: 기억해, 항상 아이들의 안전을 최우선으로 생각해!

passageLines.text: On Thursday, Mr. Anderson takes me to the vet.
passageLines.ko: 목요일에, 앤더슨 씨가 나를 동물병원에 데려간다.

passageLines.text: Once every six months, he takes me for a checkup.

passageLines.text: Don't worry.

passageLines.ko: 앤더슨 씨는 그날 밤에 휴대폰을 되찾는다.

passageLines.text: On Friday, Mrs. Anderson takes me for a walk.

passageLines.text: On Saturday, Mr. and Mrs. Anderson go for a drive with me.
passageLines.ko: 토요일에, 앤더슨 씨 부부가 나와 함께 드라이브를 간다.

passageLines.text: They are not wearing seatbelts.

I remind them to wear seatbelts.
